summary: Design ready: 250-seat/five-floor guest journey and staff/kitchen workflow; all six services; customer/staff Foundry agents with bounded kitchen specialist. Orders remain deterministic during AI failure. Targets: 50 req/s normal, 150 burst; chat measured separately. Confirm before any implementation.
evidence: No diagrams, Bicep, app implementation, Azure queries, what-if, deployment, runtime success, suitability approval or hack composition performed.

decision.question: Confirm this design for local implementation: full restaurant journey with explicitly synthetic settlement (no money charged), Basic Foundry using gpt-5.4-mini 2026-03-17 GlobalStandard in provisional East US 2, TLS/Entra public service endpoints, separate web/chat/worker apps, Cosmos outbox and Service Bus Premium? All six requested services are retained; supporting ACR, VNet, Entra and observability are justified. Infrastructure allowance is $980-$1,920/month plus model usage, not a quote. Confirmation permits diagrams, Bicep, app and local tests only.
decision.reason: The workflow requires explicit architecture confirmation before implementation. This includes payment boundaries, managed Foundry state/global inference, public networking and Premium broker cost. It grants neither Azure preparation/deployment permission nor deployed-scenario suitability approval.
